answer:
The motto of the oldest California State University is **"Powering Silicon Valley"**. 

San José State University (SJSU), located in San Jose, California, was founded in 1857 as one of the first public institutions of higher education in California. It later became part of the CSU system and is recognized as the oldest campus within that network.
